page_title: Keep Enterprise Deals Moving With a Shared Close Plan
meta_description: Done-for-you mutual action plans, recap emails, and blocker tracking for B2B SaaS teams selling enterprise deals.
for_whom: For B2B SaaS teams selling $10k-$150k ACV deals into mid-market and enterprise accounts
hero_headline: Stop letting qualified enterprise deals die of drift
hero_subheadline: We build and run a buyer-friendly mutual action plan so every deal has clear owners, next steps, and momentum.
credibility_line: Least-privilege access. You approve buyer-facing updates. No CRM overhaul required.
pain_paragraph: Your team leaves a promising call feeling good, then the deal slows down because next steps live in scattered notes, buyers miss deadlines, and late security or procurement asks show up with no owner. A shared close plan gives everyone one place to see what happens next and what is blocking the deal.
before: Late-stage deals slip two to six weeks without a clear reason
AEs and founders keep rewriting recap emails from scratch
Security, legal, and procurement tasks surface too late
Forecast calls rely on optimism instead of visible next steps
after: Every active deal has a clean mutual action plan with named owners
Meeting recaps turn into concrete next steps the same day
Blockers get chased before they become silent stalls
Leadership gets a clearer signal on which deals are real
offer_summary: ClosePlan Desk is a done-for-you deal coordination layer for late-stage B2B SaaS deals. We set up the shared close plan, capture next steps after meetings, keep follow-through moving, and surface blockers before the deal goes cold.
included: Deal intake + stakeholder map for each active opportunity
Buyer-friendly mutual action plan with milestones and owners
Same-day recap email draft after key meetings
Blocker tracker for security, legal, pilot, and procurement asks
Twice-weekly deal status summary with stale-step alerts
excluded: Negotiating pricing or contract terms on your behalf
Acting as the named account executive
Custom CRM rebuilds or sales process redesign
process: 15-min fit call to confirm your deal stage, motion, and current blockers
Onboarding: we set up the close-plan template, stakeholder map, and update cadence
For each deal: recap meetings, update the mutual action plan, and chase blockers
Weekly review: confirm forecast confidence, risks, and next-step ownership
pricing_details: Starter includes shared close plans, meeting recap support, and twice-weekly follow-through. Higher-volume or higher-stakes deals price up based on stakeholder count and cadence.
guarantee_line: Pilot option: start with one live deal for 2 weeks. If you do not leave with a cleaner close plan and clearer next steps, do not continue.

faq.q: How do you access our deal information safely?
faq.a: We work with least-privilege access only: call notes, CRM records, and shared docs as needed. No production systems. You control what buyer-facing messages get sent.

faq.q: What needs to be true for this to work?
faq.a: You need at least one real late-stage deal, a named internal owner, and willingness to use one shared close plan. This works best when the buyer already has active momentum, not a dead pipeline opportunity.
Usually 1-2 business days. We gather your current deal notes, stakeholders, and next steps, then stand up the first plan and reporting rhythm.

faq.q: How long do you retain our deal materials?
faq.a: Only for active work unless you ask otherwise. We can work with a defined retention window and delete materials on request.

faq.q: Will you talk directly to our buyer?
faq.a: Only if you want that and the motion supports it. By default, we draft and coordinate behind the scenes while your AE or founder stays customer-facing.

trust_basics_line: Not sales, legal, or procurement advice. You remain the owner of customer communication and commercial decisions.
